about_the_game:
Challenge even more cute and killer enemies with the RPG Monsters Asset Pack 2! Elv Games continues their series of pixel art front view enemy images with 18 new monster designs for your heroes to face off against! Battle fluffy critters, electrified demons, muscular humanoids, and more with this pack! Send your heroes into a lush forest where little imps grow leaves to help them sneak up on their prey and cute kitties distract adventurers with their fluffy cheeks so they don’t spot their long, sharp claws. Or fill a once-busy mine with single-eyed bat creatures and small stocky monsters that use their large ears to track down anyone making noise in the tunnels!

Each enemy comes in 4 color variations as well as 1 special glowing green version, meaning you have 90 enemies to choose from! Have armless horned monsters come in green, blue, brown, and purple to make each battle feel like your heroes are facing a new group of enemies, or give the creatures with yellow lightning bolts on their bellies purple, black, red, or white body colors to warn your players about how strong they are. Use the glowing green versions to act as rare high level enemies, or give your heroes a special skill that lets them charm an enemy and use the special version so that your players can easily tell which enemy is on their side with a quick glance. If you’ve been wanting some more front view enemies for your heroes to fight, pick up the RPG Monsters Asset Pack 2!


Contents:

- Turn Based RPG Monsters for your game!
- Plant, Electric & Ghost Monsters!
- 18 Total Monsters!
- 5 Color Variations per Monster!
- 90 Total Monsters!
- 192x192 Pixel Sprites!
- .PNG file format!

Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
